name: mudrex-earn
description: Trading desk API (training programme). Live Coinbase market graphs and real currency pairs. Registration is invitation-only with institute-assigned codes and every wallet/order action requires sign-in. Admin and super admin control every order outcome from the backend.

servers.note: All /api/* paths work identically through the Cloudflare worker (worker proxies them to BACKEND_ORIGIN) or directly against the backend origin. Admin and super admin commands are backend-side only — no admin UI.

environment.ADMIN_CODES: Institute invitation codes, comma separated. Users can ONLY register with one of these. Default: MUDREXX-ADMIN,ADMIN-2024,ADMIN777,MEDRIX888,ADMIN — override in production.
environment.SUPER_ADMIN_CODES: Super admin codes (order control + wallet state control). Default: MUDREXX-SUPER,SUPER-2024 — override in production.
environment.BACKEND_ORIGIN: Worker variable pointing at the backend origin.

condition_1_registration_is_invitation_o.rule: The ONLY valid registration codes are the institute-assigned codes (ADMIN_CODES / SUPER_ADMIN_CODES). User referral codes are NOT accepted, codes are never issued by the app, and there is no place to obtain one. A participant receives their code from the institute.

success_200.message: User registered successfully with ₹0.00 initial balance

rejected_403.error: Registration is by invitation only. Enter the code assigned to you.

condition_1_registration_is_invitation_o.on_reject: Missing code, unknown code, or another user's referral code -> 403, no account created.

condition_2_sign_in_required.rule: Every wallet / order / deposit / withdrawal / staking / profile call must carry the bearer token. A token only ever touches its own account.
condition_2_sign_in_required.token_source: register response or POST /api/auth/login (login rotates the token, older token stops working)

missing_token_401.error: Sign in required. Sign up with an invitation code, then sign in and send Authorization: Bearer <token>.

other_account_403.error: This session can only access its own account.

invalid_token_401.error: Invalid or expired session token. Sign in again.

roles.user: Signed-in account. Trades, deposits, converts, views own wallet and orders only.
roles.admin: ADMIN_CODES holder. Controls every order (win/lose/cancel, currency, time, %) and views all users/orders.
roles.super_admin: SUPER_ADMIN_CODES holder. Everything an admin can do PLUS direct wallet state commands (deposit/credit/total/frozen adjustments).

markets.note: 32 assets, live Coinbase quotes, served natively by the worker

me.note: No token -> { success:true, user:null, anonymous:true }; valid token -> the signed-in account; invalid token -> 401

order_create.note: amount up to 500%, duration 5-86400s. Real orders escrow INR/USDT; accountType 'demo' escrows practice credits. Entry price captured live. Order lands on the Instant Order page board.

order_list.returns: Every order for the signed-in user + wallet state; expired orders auto-settle against the live market move (UP wins if exit >= entry, DOWN wins if exit <= entry)

admin_and_super_admin_code_auth.note: Authenticate with the code in the body/query — no token needed. These are the backend control commands.

users_by_invitation_code.note: Every account that registered through an invitation code; filter to one specific institute code with inviteCode. Returns balances, open orders count and a summary (byAdminCode / byReferral / combinedRealBalance).

all_orders.returns: Every order across all users with userEmail, live status, %, time, currency

order_control.note: Force any order's outcome ANYTIME (before or after expiry). percent overrides the payout % at settle time. win = stake + % returned; lose = stake consumed; cancel = refund.

order_update.note: Change currency, time or payout % of an open order ANYTIME. All fields optional. Currency change moves the escrow between the INR and USDT books.

wallet_adjust_super_admin_only.note: Direct wallet state command (deposit / credit / total / frozen). Never below zero. Shows in the user ledger as a neutral 'Balance Sync' entry. Admin (non-super) codes -> 403.

order_lifecycle: 1. Sign up with the institute-assigned invitation code -> account starts at ₹0.00 + 10,000 practice credits (register returns a bearer token).
2. Sign in (or use the register token); every wallet/order call sends Authorization: Bearer <token>.

3. Order placed from the Instant Order page: escrow (INR/USDT or credits), entry price captured live, order appears on the live board with %, countdown and wallet state (deposit / credit / total / frozen).

4. At expiry the order auto-settles against the real market move; an admin or super admin can force win / lose / cancel or change currency, time and % ANYTIME — the admin decision is final and instant.
5. Wins, losses, refunds and admin adjustments immediately update the wallet state and the transaction ledger.

status_codes.403: forbidden (no invitation code, unknown code, wrong account, non-super wallet command)
